t: The Tectite Sprint Copper Push-Fit Equal Tee 10mm provides a reliable and efficient solution for creating branch connections in copper pipework. This 10mm equal tee is ideal for various plumbing installations, including domestic and commercial water systems, ensuring a secure and tamperproof joint. Its simple push-fit mechanism allows for quick installation without the need for hot works or specialist tools, saving valuable time on site. The fitting guarantees electrical continuity on copper pipe and maintains high performance, operating effectively at up to 114°C and 10bar pressure. It is suitable for both hard and soft water areas and is approved for drinking water applications.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
Simple Push-Fit Installation for Quick Connection
Guaranteed Electrical Continuity on Copper Pipe
